articles.title: Hackers plant crypto-stealing code on 178 major websites, including HSBC and Ledger
articles.description: An Optimizely signup flaw let an attacker plant address-swapping code on websites including HSBC, the BBC and Ledger. The total stolen remains unknown, and investigators have not linked the attack to AI.

articles.title: Nvidia faces first earnings test without Jensen Huang as AI stocks slide
articles.description: With shares almost 40% below their October peak, Nvidia’s guidance could carry more weight than quarterly results as investors assess its direction without Jensen Huang.

articles.title: Google says hackers use AI agents to find and exploit software flaws
articles.description: Google says attackers are using AI agents to find and exploit software flaws automatically, reducing the time organizations have to apply patches.

articles.title: Nvidia Board Not Considering Jensen Huang's Return: Report
articles.description: The board is focused on its probe into the ousted co-founder, a source told CNBC, despite Donald Trump and Elon Musk backing his return.

articles.title: US judge clears brothers in $25M Ethereum MEV case after mistrial
articles.description: Judge Jessica Clarke said the transactions did not involve false promises, but the ruling did not determine whether the brothers’ conduct was ethical or violated other laws.

articles.title: Judge Acquits MIT Brothers in $25M Ethereum MEV Case, Ending Prosecution
articles.description: A federal judge ruled prosecutors failed to prove the material misrepresentation needed for wire fraud, a year after a jury deadlocked.

articles.title: Deutsche Bank shares sink as whistleblowers reveal Epstein payments, Trump tax leak, Russia bets
articles.description: A 15-million-file leak details alleged control failures at Deutsche Bank, including Epstein-linked payments and a Trump tax blunder.

articles.title: Binance hacker moves $63 million in stolen ether after 2 weeks of silence
articles.description: North Korea's TraderTraitor group transferred 34,279 ETH to three new wallets. The funds have not moved again, blockchain investigators say.

articles.title: Goldman Sachs reports $1.22B in Ether ETFs as ETHA share count jumps
articles.description: Goldman Sachs increased its Ether ETF shares in Q3, bringing its reported holdings to $1.22 billion, while reshuffling its Bitcoin ETF positions.

articles.title: Solana Foundation Backs CoinGecko as Crypto Data Giant Eyes Trading
articles.description: CoinGecko has received backing from the Solana Foundation to expand into market intelligence and explore trading.

articles.title: South Korea will suspend all aircraft operation for 35 minutes and markets will open late. Here’s why
articles.description: South Korea will suspend aircraft takeoffs and landings nationwide for 35 minutes on Thursday to minimize noise during a college entrance exam.

articles.title: Bitcoin could slide into the $50,000s as Fed rate hike bets build, Wintermute says
articles.description: Bitcoin may slide into the $50,000s after losing its 200-week average, with ETF outflows, weak demand and rate-hike risks weighing on BTC, leading market maker warns.

articles.title: Nvidia warns chip buyers of legal risks tied to China AI access, sources tell CNBC
articles.description: The U.S. Commerce Department is making moves to tighten export controls.

articles.title: U.S. agencies say they initiated investigation into Nvidia partner Megaspeed in 2024
articles.description: The Commerce and Justice departments said in a joint statement that U.S. investigations into Megaspeed began in 2024.

articles.title: Cardano Foundation seeks $5 million from treasury using ADA price 33% above market
articles.description: The Foundation wants 25 million ADA for 12 global events, even as the token trades well below the 20 cent price used to size the request.

articles.title: Ex-Robinhood engineer pleads guilty to $125K Hyperliquid trading scheme
articles.description: The former Robinhood engineer used confidential information about upcoming Robinhood token listings to trade on Hyperliquid.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Iran escalates threats as third U.S. carrier arrives in Middle East, tanker struck in Hormuz
articles.description: Iran has ratcheted up threats against U.S. forces as a third American aircraft carrier arrived in the Gulf, stoking fears of a resumption of military tensions.

articles.title: Wells Fargo's reported BlackRock bitcoin ETF holdings double to $2.35 billion
articles.description: The bank's reported BlackRock bitcoin ETF position doubled to $2.35 billion in the third quarter, giving it exposure to roughly 28,000 BTC.

articles.title: Ripple-backed Evernorth has written down its pre-listing XRP holdings by 60%
articles.description: The company’s accounting policy requires it to record price declines without reversing those write-downs when XRP recovers.
